therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Multi-kinase inhibition combined with immune checkpoint blockade
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Tumor angiogenesis inhibition and T-cell activation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Participants with selected solid tumors (RCC, EC, melanoma, NSCLC, HNSCC, UC, leiomyosarcoma)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Objective Response Rate (ORR) based on irRECIST v1.1 at Week 24

results.target_engagement_evidence: Plasma concentrations of lenvatinib demonstrated drug exposure across all cycles with steady-state levels achieved
subgroup_findings: Highest response rates observed in RCC (56.6%) and melanoma (47.6%)
results.dose_information: Lenvatinib 20 mg daily orally (RP2D), Pembrolizumab 200 mg IV every 3 weeks in 21-day cycles

context.duration: Up to 73 months treatment and follow-up
